dedupe_keys.name: wmata open data hub washington metro

description: The WMATA Open Data Hub gathers the Washington Metropolitan Area Transit Authority's interactive dashboards, performance reporting and downloadable data. The Service Excellence Dashboard covers rail, bus and MetroAccess for the past year with key indicators such as on-time performance, missed trips and prediction accuracy. The ridership dashboards use fare system data on rail and bus ridership and parking use, with monthly PDF summaries of ridership trends, and the Pedshed and Bikeshed Atlas 2.0 maps walking and cycling access around stations. Developer APIs are documented on a separate developers page, and other data can be requested from WMATA's research council. Coverage is the Washington metropolitan area. Access: free dashboards and downloads on the WMATA website; licence terms for the downloads are not stated on the hub page read. Caveats: the performance dashboard covers only the past year, and much of the content is presented as dashboards, not bulk files. It supports public transport service performance and reliability analysis, ridership-based demand estimation, station accessibility studies and disruption impact assessment, and complements the Mobility Database GTFS feeds catalogued here.
